services.desc: Led by practicing artists, JCAL arts classes inspire self-expression and skill-building at every level. This semester marks the return of acting classes at JCAL, and introduces new titles like songwriting to our lineup. Please note - adult classes are an hour and a half for 5 weeks, while kids and teens class are one hour, for 12 weeks. Also, JCAL’s Membership program is back. Become a Member for deep discounts on classes, plus free events and more. Students will dive into fun, hands-on projects that spark their imaginations while learning essential art skills like color mixing, composition, and creating their own masterpieces.
